caption: The object in the drawing is a fireplace bellows depicted in a vertical orientation, with an elongated dark metal nozzle at the bottom and a pair of handles at the top. The main body of the bellows is a rounded, teardrop shape, predominantly tan or light brown in color with a red section running along the left edge and adorned with circular metal studs or decorative nails around the perimeter. The middle of the bellows features an oval panel with a painted scene displaying two human figures, one standing and one seated, in a natural outdoor setting with trees and foliage, rendered in muted tones. The upper end has two rectangular-shaped handles, one on each side, with a pink or red cord tied through the right handle. The artist’s name, “John Koehl,” is written in small letters at the lower right of the drawing. The background is a plain off-white or beige color.
title: Painted Bellows
